setting_basic_source_auto_update_tip: Applies to all custom and built-in sources: sources with an update address are checked at the frequency selected in "Music API update check". New versions are installed automatically and rolled back if the new script fails to load. Each source's own "Check for updates" button is not affected by this switch.

setting_basic_use_system_file_selector_t:
When this option is enabled, operations such as importing backup files, Music APIs, etc. will not need to request storage permissions, but may not be available on some systems.

You can turn off the option to fallback to the app's built-in file selector if you are unable to import files after enabling the option.
setting_dislike_list_tips:
1. One line per entry. If there is an "@" symbol in the name of the song or artist, it needs to be replaced with "#"
2. Specify a song by a certain artist: song_name@artist_name
3. Specify a song: song_name
4. Specify an artist: @artist_name

setting_play_audio_offload_tip:
You can enable this option to save power consumption, but on some devices there may be an issue where all songs prompt "Error loading music" or "Unable to play the whole song in full", this is due to a bug in the current system. 

For those experiencing this issue you can turn off the option and restart the app completely and try again.
setting_play_auto_clean_played_list_tip: In the shuffle mode, when switching between songs by clicking on a song in the same list as playlist, if "Automatically empty played list" is enabled, the songs in the list will participate in the random again.
setting_play_cache_size_save_tip: The cache is set and takes effect after restarting the app.
setting_play_preload_next_tip: Fetches the next song's cover, lyrics and colors in advance so switching feels instant. It only affects how fast switching feels, not sound quality.

user_api_auto_update_desc: When enabled, this source is checked for a new version at the frequency you pick under "Music API update check", and the update is applied for you. Older versions are skipped automatically. If the new script turns out not to work, this source is rolled back to the version you had before. You can also tap "Check for updates" on this source at any time to check it once right now.
user_api_auto_update_success_tip: Music API "{name}" has been auto updated
builtin_source_local_fixed: Bundled locally and no update address was provided; tap "Manual update" to enter one
builtin_source_note: Built-in sources are provided by third-party authors and bundled by the app. Both online and local sources can check for new versions: if the script declares an update address, it will update automatically or manually; otherwise new scripts arrive with app updates. Scripts can access the network, so enable only the ones you trust.
builtin_source_tab_local_desc: Bundled with the app. If the author declared an update address in the script, you can check for new versions here too. Automatic updates follow the "Music API update check" schedule.
builtin_source_tab_online_desc: The author provides an update address, so you can check for new versions here. Automatic updates follow the "Music API update check" schedule.
user_api_import_syntax_failed_tip: The script is incomplete or has syntax errors, so the file published at this address itself seems broken ({message})

user_api_max_tip:

If you want to continue importing, please remove some unnecessary APIs to make room.
user_api_note: TIP: Although we have isolated the API script's running environment as much as possible, importing API scripts containing malicious behaviors may still affect your system. Please import them with caution.
